FY2027 Strategic Investment Grants

Strategic Investment Grants (SIG) provide up to $1000 for sample expenses. SIG enables artists to advance and supports nonprofit organizations in arts programs.

Application Deadline

Applications are due on the 15th of each month by 11:59 p.m. Applications are reviewed the following month.

For help, write to someone@example.org.

Grant Guidelines

SIG has distinct eligibility requirements for artist applicants and 501(c)3 organization applicants.
